description: React component CreateLessonForm for creating lessons with title, description, links, file upload, and progress indication; includes validation, mock mode handling, and UI elements.

methods.name: showToast
methods.description: Displays a toast message of a given type for 3 seconds.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates form inputs, including title, links, and optional file.

methods.name: onAddLink
methods.description: Adds a new link input if under maximum limit.

methods.name: onRemoveLink
methods.description: Removes a link input at specified index.

methods.name: onLinkChange
methods.description: Updates link value at specified index.

methods.name: resetForm
methods.description: Resets form fields and errors to initial state.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission: validation, creating lesson, uploading file, updating progress, and showing success/error messages.
